page: Amazon Web Services g5g.2xlarge is an arm64-based virtual machine powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores utilizing the AWS ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor architecture, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. This server is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It integrates a single NVIDIA Turing T4G GPU with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not included on this instance, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average performance across several compute and memory metrics, alongside notable weaknesses in specific workloads. The system achieved average ratings in stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, as well as in Geekbench multi-core and software compilation. However, single-core performance is weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 950.0 and weak results in gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. Cryptographic capabilities are a significant bottleneck, with the Passmark CPU encryption test returning a poor score. Large-block memory write bandwidth is measured at 53.67 GB/sec, while read-only cached small-block bandwidth reaches 472.81 GB/sec.

Given the ARM64 architecture combined with an NVIDIA T4G GPU, this instance is designed for graphics-intensive workloads, ray tracing, and image processing, where it demonstrates average benchmark performance. However, it is poorly suited for large language model inference, with text generation speeds for a small 135M model registering at a poor 36.51 tokens/sec and a medium 7B model at 6.16 tokens/sec. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the g5g.2xlarge offers a specialized hardware profile that pairs energy-efficient ARM cores with dedicated GPU acceleration, making it a viable option for entry-level GPU workloads, Android game streaming, and lightweight graphics rendering, provided that high cryptographic throughput or high-speed local storage is not required.
description: Amazon Web Services g5g.2xlarge is an arm64-based virtual machine featuring 8 dedicated AWS ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. It includes a dedicated NVIDIA Turing T4G GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, though it lacks local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Benchmarks show average performance in multi-core processing, software compilation, and ray tracing, but reveal weaknesses in single-core execution, text processing, and cryptographic operations. Due to these performance characteristics, the instance is best suited for graphics-intensive applications, image processing, and lightweight GPU-accelerated workloads. It is less optimal for large language model inference or tasks requiring high cryptographic throughput.
